Probe Launched After Drone Spotted Over Viyoor Central Jail

A probe has been launched after a drone was spotted flying over Viyoor Central Jail in Kerala. The incident has raised security concerns regarding the prison facility. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the drone sighting.
